title: Timeout does not prove a transfer never started
observations: The r59 never-started hypothesis was overturned by a later first-poll control sample showing departure from idle.
interpretation: Distinguish start, deadline and callback observations rather than attributing a timeout to one event.
counterevidence: Later late callbacks do not prove the cause of every earlier timeout.
unresolved_questions: Which current samples and timings distinguish the competing hypotheses?

source_references.summary: Historical first-poll sample and hypothesis update.
